Building a 3D Volume Rendering App with 2D Transfer Functions
This tutorial walks through how to build an interactive 2D transfer function editor with volume rendering, using: VTK for 3D visualization and volume rendering PyQt5 for the GUI Matplotlib for 2D histogram interaction SimpleITK for medical image processing NumPy for numerical computations
